games.review_note: Visually reviewed the full real-input discovery: title and dive, Q sonar, WASD approach to all three mounds, E brushing to 70% each, carrying, three mouse drags into lit sockets, clockwise mouse crank to 223 months, eclipse, and the end card with All three found in 0:55. End card reached at 179.45s. Separate fresh dive naturally exhausted its 120-second air supply: Hauled up to the boat at 138.00s, automatic title return at 152.63s. Reviewed 5-second captures and named milestone screenshots. Both modes auto-verdict ok; no page/console errors, failed requests, black/frozen frames or stalls. Playwright logged TargetClosedError teardown warnings after context closure; the command exited 0. No state writes, timer acceleration, teleporting or pointer-lock shim.
